title: Learning to Be a Transformer to Pinpoint Anomalies
mechanism: Shallow MLP students mimic attention-layer patch mappings of a frozen ViT on high-resolution inputs; adds defect-size-stratified evaluation metrics.
adaptation: High-resolution AD prior at native 1,200 px for pool sources that have it; and adopt size-stratified metrics in the benchmark: crack recall by component length bins (<20, 20-100, >100 px).
evidence: R: SOTA on MVTec AD, best segmentation on VisA; better robustness across defect sizes by their metrics.
min_experiment: Benchmark: add length-binned crack recall to the protocol (no GPU). Prior arm only if the WeakREST arm passes.
prior_overlap: none; 2x input resolution n.d. was for the supervised model, not an AD prior
